import csv,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
import fitz
from benchmark_tools.prepare_ob_candidate_neighborhood import record,check
from benchmark_tools.probe_dgx_step_separation import save
root=Path.cwd()
base=root/"benchmark_tools/results"
stem="native_qfo_terminal_failures_20261009_v1"
report_path=base/stem/"report.json"
manuscript=base/(stem+"_manuscript.md")
pdf=base/(stem+"_print/document.pdf")
assets_path=base/(stem+"_html_assets.json")
layout_path=base/(stem+"_layout_review/report.json")
citations_path=base/(stem+"_citations.json")
output=base/(stem+"_content_readback.json")
assert not output.exists() and not output.is_symlink()
report=json.loads(report_path.read_text())
assets=json.loads(assets_path.read_text())
layout=json.loads(layout_path.read_text())
citations=json.loads(citations_path.read_text())
refs=[record(p) for p in (report_path,manuscript,pdf,assets_path,layout_path,citations_path)]
rows={row["cell"]:row for row in report["rows"]}
old=json.loads(Path(report["references"]["snapshot"]["path"]).read_text())
assert [r for r in report["rows"] if r["accuracy_admitted"]]==[r for r in old["rows"] if r["accuracy_admitted"]]
scores=list(csv.DictReader((base/stem/"scores.tsv").open(),delimiter="\t"))
statuses=list(csv.DictReader((base/stem/"status.tsv").open(),delimiter="\t"))
assert len(scores)==42 and {(s["Cell"],s["Endpoint"]) for s in scores}=={(c,e) for c,r in rows.items() for e in r["scores"]}
for s in scores:
    row=rows[s["Cell"]]; value=row["scores"][s["Endpoint"]]
    assert s["Accuracy Admitted"]==str(row["accuracy_admitted"])
    assert s["Value"]=="Unavailable" if value is None else float(s["Value"])==value
assert len(statuses)==7 and {s["Cell"] for s in statuses}==set(rows)
for s in statuses:
    row=rows[s["Cell"]]; value=row["secondary_mean"]
    assert s["Status"]==row["status"] and s["Accuracy Admitted"]==str(row["accuracy_admitted"])
    assert s["Secondary Mean"]=="Unavailable" if value is None else float(s["Secondary Mean"])==value
with fitz.open(pdf) as document:
    text=" ".join(" ".join(page.get_text().split()) for page in document)
    assert len(document)==layout["page_count"]==22 and not layout["bounds_violations"]
    for row in rows.values():
        if row["accuracy_admitted"]:
            for value in row["scores"].values(): assert f"{value:.8f}" in text
    for phrase in ("SIGSEGV", "OUT_OF_MEMORY", "11,755,521", "585,180/984,137", "exited-11", "64526.103655", "1739733.457142", "20492017664"):
        assert phrase in text,phrase
    assert text.count("Unavailable")>=3
decoded=[]
for ref in assets["targets"]:
    check(ref)
    path=Path(ref["path"])
    if path.suffix.lower()==".pdf":
        with fitz.open(path) as document:
            assert document.is_pdf and len(document)>0
            for page in document:
                pix=page.get_pixmap(matrix=fitz.Matrix(.5,.5))
                assert len(set(pix.samples))>1
            decoded.append(dict(file=ref,pages=len(document),all_pages_decoded_nonblank=True))
assert len(decoded)==10 and len(assets["citation_ids"])==19 and not citations["unresolved_citations"]
assert assets["citation_ids"]==citations["matched_bibliography_ids"]
assert sorted(int(Path(ref["path"]).stem.split("_")[-1]) for ref in layout["rendered_pages"])==list(range(1,23))
for ref in [*refs,*report["outputs"],*layout["rendered_pages"]]: check(ref)
result=dict(schema="native_qfo_terminal_failure_content_readback_v1",references=refs,
    validation_code=sys.argv[1],python_version=sys.version,pymupdf_version=fitz.__version__,
    score_rows_checked=42,status_rows_checked=7,unchanged_admitted_rows=4,missing_endpoint_values=18,
    rendered_endpoint_values_checked=24,rendered_failure_phrases_checked=8,
    pages=22,pages_rendered_for_manual_review=22,bounds_violations=[],
    direct_local_link_occurrences=assets["local_occurrences"],direct_local_targets=len(assets["targets"]),
    linked_pdf_assets_decoded=decoded,citation_ids=assets["citation_ids"],unresolved_citations=[],
    new_scientific_admission=False,publication_ready=False,
    limitations=["Direct CSV/JSON/PDF metadata/content and asset decoding, not new raw scientific admission.",
        "Bounds and decoding do not establish manual visual review; that observation is recorded separately.",
        "No transitive raw provenance, full runtime restoration, rights clearance or DOI deposition is established."])
save(output,result)
print(json.dumps(dict(content_readback=record(output),pages=22,score_rows_checked=42,linked_pdfs_decoded=len(decoded),publication_ready=False),sort_keys=True))
